newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH FINANCE SECTOR 96 OP PROFITS UP 245 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH FINANCE SECTOR 96 OP PROFITS UP 245 PCT.

text.p: The operating profits of finance companies represented by the Finnish Finance Houses Association more than doubled in 1996 on te previous year, the association said on Wednesday.

"The combined operating profits of member companies of the Finnish Finance Houses Association rose to 552 million markka in 1996 from the previous year's 160 million markka," the association said in a statement.
It represents six bank-owned finance houses, Handelsbanken Rahoitus Oy, Merita Asiakasrahoitus Oy, Merita Rahoitus Oy, OP-Rahoitus Oy, PSP-rahoitus Oy and Suomen Tililuotto Oy.
"The decline in credit losses can be considered the clearest reason for the improvement in earnings," it said.
"Tougher competition has made margins so small that maintaining earnings at last year's level may be difficult if there is no increase in sales," association chairman Pasi Vare said in the statement.
